summary:
Comprehensive plan for remediating all 8 critical blockers from the Live Production Audit (28.10.2026):
1. P0 Payment Security: Strict server-side Telegram initData HMAC validation on /api/payments/stars/create (HTTP 401 on missing/invalid initData, removal of 'tg_user' production fallback, server-authoritative userId extraction).
2. P0 Order Status API: Implementation of /functions/api/payments/stars/status.ts returning JSON with auth verification, 401 for unauthorized, 404 for missing orders, 403 for unauthorized access to other users' orders.
3. P0 Telegram payment webhook lifecycle (pre_checkout_query < 10s, successful_payment idempotency, server-verified PRO activation).
4. TON Wallet Connect: Public PNG icon (180x180), manifest schema compliance, single root TonConnectUIProvider, PortfolioScreen connect flow with auto-closing picker, masked friendly address (UQAb12...xYz9), copy, explorer, disconnect, useIsConnectionRestored state handling.
5. Market Data Freshness: Honest STALE/DELAYED status with lastUpdatedAt timestamp, stale threshold, retry button, no fake LIVE on cache.
6. Academy UA/EN/RU Full Localization: Instant switching of titles, descriptions, levels, tags, quiz, video titles, and fallback messages.
7. Loading Screen & Onboarding Polish: Rotating concentric rings transforming into StorkCrypto at 100%, strict 6.5s duration, single-line responsive title on 360x800, distinct onboarding layer.
